fieldStrategy: Deep-clone each card. Keep current_platform_state, evidence, notes, categories, rights, and attribution. Add sibling current_availability. freshness is fresh, stale, or not_current. Invalid or missing timestamps, a reversed window, and a future observation are not_current. now equal to fresh_until is fresh with reason exact_expiry. A fresh integer count of zero or more is projected with reason observed. A fresh null or malformed count is null with reason unknown. Every other time state projects null with reason not_current. caller_claimable and verified_chain_time stay null. Projection logic contains no platform name, incident date, or census fact.
